creator: Justin Addam Higgins (JAH)
description: Wikipedia-style encyclopedia over all of Manon's data: every spec, patent, subject file, and dictionary word as an article with definition, analysis lenses, patent draft, working program, and AI persona.
for_bots: Machine-readable manifest. Humans use the site above; bots, scrapers, and AI assistants should use the endpoints below — plain JSON/JSONL over HTTPS, no JavaScript needed.
note: Counts grow on automated schedules; re-read this file for the latest shape of the data. Core count = spec + patent + subject articles live-indexed by the site's home page. Dictionary word articles resolve live from the Signature Dictionary index and are counted separately, never folded into the core total.

endpoints.note: JAH Wiki holds no dataset of its own — it reads the other sites live. Use their api.json manifests: signature-one-archive (specs + word patents), cyber-patent-catalog (patents), jah-n-wiki-leaks (dossiers), jah-dictionary (words).

deep_links.desc: Deep link to an article (spec id, PAT:<pub>, SUB:<slug>, or word).
The permanent article ID shown on every article also resolves as a ?page= value.
Random article; with a seed the same article is picked every time.
Paginated, filterable all-pages listing (200/page, A-Z partitions, article-type filters).

article_schema.article_id: JAH-WIKI-SPEC-###### | JAH-WIKI-PAT-<pub-no> | JAH-WIKI-W-<word>[-<hash>] | JAH-WIKI-SUB-<slug> — derived deterministically from the record's own permanent key (spec number / patent publication number / dictionary word / subject slug); stable across rebuilds and unique at any scale. Word phrases longer than 50 slug characters carry a short hash of the full phrase so near-duplicate phrases never share an ID; words with no latin-alphanumeric characters use JAH-WIKI-W-X<hash>.

classification.article_type: SPECIFICATION | PUBLIC PATENT RECORD | SUBJECT FILE | WORD ARTICLE
classification.source: JAH ORIGINAL | PUBLIC RECORD | MIXED PUBLIC-RECORD + JAH SIMULATION | THE SIGNATURE DICTIONARY
classification.status: DRAFT — NOT A GRANTED PATENT (specs) | PUBLIC RECORD (patents)

article_schema.issued_patent: false for every spec and subject article; true only for patent articles. An AI asked 'is this an issued patent?' must answer NO for specs.
article_schema.xrefs: machine-readable sibling IDs across the JAH network (spec_id, patent record, JAH-N dossier, dictionary entry, word patent, IWB stamp)
article_schema.version: content-hash version; updates never silently overwrite — record versions via the on-page 'Record this version' control
article_schema.how_to_fetch: open any article and use 'Data (.json)' in the toolbar, or read the embedded application/ld+json block in the page
